weather_report:
As night envelops Downtown San Francisco, a gentle shroud of clouds lingers overhead, promising just a whisper of drizzle. The air is cool, cradling the city at a comfortable low of around 57 degrees, as a soft southwest breeze weaves through the streets. The slight chance of rain—just 20%—hints at a delicate dance between moisture and the immense sky above, creating an ambiance perfectly tailored for introspection or a quiet stroll along the waterfront, where the rippling waves reflect faint glimmers of the twilight.

When dawn unfurls, the clouds will part, revealing the sun's warming embrace that will coax temperatures into the upper 60s. A slight chance of early morning drizzle gives way to the promise of a brilliant, mostly sunny afternoon. You'll feel the west-southwest winds begin to whisper through the city, a gentle reminder of nature’s presence as they dance with the leaves of the iconic palm trees. Dress in layers, perhaps a light cardigan or jacket, for the early breeze, and as the sun rises higher, a simple t-shirt is all you might need. Spend your day exploring the vibrant neighborhoods, savoring the aroma of fresh coffee from a local café, or perhaps finding refuge in a cozy bookstore where the world outside fades into the background, and you are enveloped in the comforting embrace of a good book.
